<!-- pr-reviewer: a8893cda509c263391722602487b98905a3b4832 -->
**Verdict: Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

What looks good
- Each write tool runs one existing command through the session History, so undo/redo work; refusals come back as tool errors. Origin/rotation inputs are checked for finite numbers (`setup_tools.rs:42-46`).
- `fixture_findings` returns hits plus `unjudged`, and both the post gate and `get_fixture_findings` read it, so a stale op is never an empty all-clear. Gate strings unchanged.
- No new `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic!` or unchecked casts in the diff; new modules carry provenance headers; new files are under 400 lines. No dependency, build.rs, scripts or `.github` changes; no `CHANGELOG.md` edit; body has `Changelog:` and `Fixes #181`; decision file is under `docs/decisions/`.
- Layering holds (tools live in the app crate; no new components).

Local results (merged with current main; the branch was already up to date, no conflicts)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `mcp_setup` | 3 passed |
| `mcp` | 9 passed |
| `posting` | 17 passed |
| `clippy -p camcraft-app --all-targets -D warnings` | clean |

Requested before merge
None.

Notes (not blocking)
- Not exercised by the author or by me: `load_machine` with a real `.mch`, rotation on `move_fixture`, fixed fixtures (no tool yet).
- `posting.rs` is 1108 lines already; the diff adds a few lines. A later split would help.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
